Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

FIG. 1 PUSHER, BAND, DENTAL, MERSHON'S PATTERN 

2.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. * 

3. Materials 

3.1 Shank— Stainless steel conforming to Designation 20Cr13 or 30Cr13 of IS: 6603-1972 
• Specification for stainless steel bars and flats'. 

3.2 Handle — Stainless steel sheet conforming to Designation 04Cr18Ni10 or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS: 6911- 
1 972 ' Specification for stainless steel plate, sheet and strip '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The band pusher shall be free from pits, cracks, seams or other surface defects. 

4.2 The handle shall have matt-finish. 

4.3 All edges shall be rounded except the working edge which shall be as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.4 The shank shall be inserted into the handle and then soldered or brazed.

4.5 The Grazing or soldering shall be neat and sound. 

4.6 The shank shall be polished bright and passlvated. 

5. Heat Treatment — The shank shall fee uMfe^ly h^r^^ed and tempered to give a hardness of 370 
to 430 HV. ?V" 

6. Tests 

6.1 Proof Load — The handle of the band pusher shall be fixed in a clamp in such a manner that the 
working portion protrudes out of the grip in horizontal plane. A load of 250 N ( approximately 25 kgf ) 
shall then be suspended from about the middle of the shank for about 2 minutes. The band pusher 
shall show no sign of damage during or after the test. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance — The band pusher shall be tested in accordance whh IS : 7531-1 975 ' Method 
for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. The 
band pusher shall show no sign of corrosion after the test. 

6.3 Leakage Test for Handle — The handle including the soldered or brazed portion of the shank shall be 
immersed in boiling wax for two minutes. There shall not be any air bubbles visible on the surface of 
the liquid. 

7. Marking — The handle of the band pusher shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufac- 
turer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and the country of manufacture. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing —As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Printed at Delhi Prlntere, New Delhi, India
